title: Fixed-exponent formal kernel and cokernel annihilation is detected on an affine cover
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\mathcal I,\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves, $F,G\in\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $\alpha:F\to G$. Let $k$ be a limiting kernel fork and $c$ a colimiting cokernel cofork for $\alpha$ in this category [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian]. Let $(U_j)_{j\in J}$ be any affine open covering of $X$, and $t\geq1$. Write $\alpha_{U_j}:\varprojlim_n F_{n+1}(U_j)\to\varprojlim_n G_{n+1}(U_j)$ for the section limit map [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-affine]. Then $\mathcal K^t k_{n+1}=\mathcal K^t c_{n+1}=0$ for every $n\in\mathbb N$ if and only if for every $j\in J$, $\mathcal K(U_j)^t$ annihilates both $\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_{U_j})$ and $\operatorname{Coker}(\alpha_{U_j})$.

source.place: Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), affine kernel description and exact restriction, together with Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087X and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087W

proof.text: Coherence gives quasi-coherence at each level. Use the surjectivity component of coherentFormalModule_affine_projections for each canonical affine limit projection. The affine-cover ideal-product criterion identifies termwise vanishing with affine section annihilation. Surjectivity and Concrete.limit_ext identify this with annihilation of each affine section limit.
Apply the two affine-limit annihilator equalities to k and c on each member of the cover; transport ideal containments in both directions and combine the two termwise conditions.

proof_origin.place: 087W/087X; affine-cover and limit-extensionality reduction, using the existing canonical affine projection theorem; R1 returned-delivery repair

theorem coherentFormalModule_annihilated_formal_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F G : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ G)
    (k : KernelFork α) (c : CokernelCofork α) (hk : IsLimit k) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (J : Type v) (U : J → X.affineOpens) (hcover : (⨆ j, (U j).1) = ⊤)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
        (k.pt.obj.obj (op n))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
        (c.pt.obj.obj (op n)))) ↔
    (∀ j : J,
      K.ideal (U j) ^ t ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(X, (U j).1) (LinearMap.ker
        (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (U j).1)))).hom) ∧
      K.ideal (U j) ^ t ≤ Module.annihilator Γ(X, (U j).1)
        (↥(limit (G.obj ⋙
          SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (U j).1)) :
          ModuleCat Γ(X, (U j).1)) ⧸ LinearMap.range
          (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (U j).1)))).hom))
